**Get auth cookie first:**
```bash

```

**Check these specific visual issues:**

1. **Button consistency** — grep all Button usage across components and check for inconsistent sizing, variants, and missing hover states:
```bash
grep -rn '<Button' components/ app/ --include="*.tsx" | grep -v node_modules | grep -v .next | wc -l
grep -rn 'variant=' components/ app/ --include="*.tsx" | grep -v node_modules | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20
```

2. **Card consistency** — are all cards using the Card component or are some using raw divs with ad-hoc styling?
```bash
grep -rn '<Card' components/ app/ --include="*.tsx" | wc -l
grep -rn 'rounded.*border.*bg-' components/ app/ --include="*.tsx" | grep -v '<Card' | grep -v 'ui/' | head -20
```

3. **Typography consistency** — check for inconsistent heading sizes across pages:
```bash
grep -rn 'text-\[1\.' components/ app/ --include="*.tsx" | head -20
grep -rn 'text-xl\|text-2xl\|text-3xl\|text-lg' app/ --include="*.tsx" | head -20
```

4. **Color consistency** — check for hardcoded colors that should be tokens:
```bash
grep -rn 'text-gray-\|bg-gray-\|text-slate-\|bg-slate-\|text-zinc-\|bg-zinc-\|bg-white\|text-black' app/ components/ --include="*.tsx" | grep -v node_modules | head -20
```

5. **Loading states** — check if pages have proper loading/skeleton states:
```bash
grep -rn 'Skeleton\|isLoading\|loading\|Suspense' app/\(app\)/ --include="*.tsx" | head -20
```

6. **Empty state consistency** — are all list pages using the EmptyState component?
```bash
grep -rn 'EmptyState\|empty-state\|No.*yet\|No.*found' app/ components/ --include="*.tsx" | grep -v node_modules | head -30
```

7. **Sidebar nav items rendering** — check actual rendered sidebar for broken icons or missing labels:
```bash
curl -s -b "$COOKIE" http://localhost:3100/dashboard | grep -oE 'data-sidebar="menu-button"[^>]*>[^<]*<' | head -20
```

8. **Check each major page for render errors:**
```bash
for path in /dashboard /calendar /appointments /clients /artists /inventory /commissions /payroll /consent-forms /settings /settings/services /settings/team /settings/billing; do
  body=$(curl -s -b "$COOKIE" "http://localhost:3100$path")
  errors=$(echo "$body" | grep -oiE 'Error|error boundary|undefined|null' | head -1)
  has_heading=$(echo "$body" | grep -oE 'text-\[1\.6\|text-2xl\|font-bold' | head -1)
  echo "$path: errors=${errors:-none} heading=${has_heading:-missing}"
done
```

9. **Check for "Coming soon" stubs vs real content:**
```bash
grep -rn 'Coming soon\|coming-soon\|Feature coming\|Sprint' app/ components/ --include="*.tsx" | grep -v node_modules | grep -v .handoffs | head -20
```

10. **Check actual dashboard HTML for card styling:**
```bash
curl -s -b "$COOKIE" http://localhost:3100/dashboard | grep -oE 'class="[^"]*card[^"]*"' | head -10
curl -s -b "$COOKIE" http://localhost:3100/dashboard | grep -oE 'class="[^"]*shadow[^"]*"' | head -10
curl -s -b "$COOKIE" http://localhost:3100/dashboard | grep -oE 'class="[^"]*border[^"]*"' | head -10
```

11. **Check for dark mode remnants that look wrong in light mode:**
```bash
grep -rn 'dark:' components/ app/ --include="*.tsx" | grep -v 'ui/' | grep -v node_modules | wc -l
grep -rn 'oklch(' components/ app/ --include="*.tsx" | grep -v globals.css | grep -v node_modules | grep -v .next | head -15
```

12. **Check the auth pages for light mode appearance:**
```bash
curl -s http://localhost:3100/login | grep -oE 'class="[^"]*bg-[^"]*"' | head -10
curl -s http://localhost:3100/signup | grep -oE 'class="[^"]*bg-[^"]*"' | head -10
```

**Report format — for each issue found:**
- File path + line number
- What's wrong (inconsistent style, missing element, broken in light mode)
- Exact fix (Tailwind classes to add/change)
- Severity (HIGH = visually broken, MEDIUM = inconsistent, LOW = polish)
